prediction_text: Direction: Barack Obama wins the 2008 US presidential election (defeating John McCain in the 4 November 2008 general election). The Saturn–Uranus opposition beginning on Election Day marks a break with the incumbent order: the change candidate prevails over the establishment/continuity candidate. Confidence: moderate.
basis: 卡面未标注 tradition/system 字段; system actually used: western (mundane/electional) astrology. Anchor on the card: Saturn opposition Uranus exact from Election Day, a configuration last seen 45 years earlier (early-1960s upheaval cycle). Saturn = the established order, age, incumbency (McCain, the older continuity candidate of the ruling party); Uranus = disruption, youth, insurgent change (Obama, who at asking time is still fighting for his own nomination — an insurgent profile). An exact Saturn–Uranus opposition activating on the day itself is read as the old order being overturned, not ratified. No natal charts are supplied on the card, so no chart-based claims are made; the reading rests solely on the stated configuration and the candidates' roles as given in the setting.
